basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: transparent desktop pet whole-character animation keyframe sheet. The attached image is the CHARACTER IDENTITY and ART STYLE REFERENCE, not a sheet to copy unchanged. Draw the same chibi DeepSeek whale girl dressed as Claude: long cobalt blue hair with cyan ends, blue whale ears with white inner rims, orange asterisk hairclip on viewer right, blue eyes, cream hoodie with orange asterisks on sleeves, orange bow and hanging Claude name badge, blue whale tail visible to viewer right. Match the existing large head, tiny body, crisp dark blue linework, soft cel shading. Waist-up leaning at the bottom of the screen, forearms resting on an INVISIBLE desktop whose edge is the same horizontal baseline throughout. Never draw a desk slab, background, chair, room, or legs. Every cell must contain a complete separately drawn character including all hair, ears, hands, tail and badge. Fixed camera, fixed scale, no zoom, identical head size and identical elbow/table baseline in all cells. Exactly EIGHT chronological poses in a clean FOUR COLUMN TWO ROW grid, left to right then top to bottom, with generous transparent gutters between figures. No cell lines, labels, numerals, captions, watermarks, motion streaks or duplicate/extra limbs. Real transparent background. No audio is needed. Smooth coherent action phases, elbows bend anatomically, maintain correct hand ownership. Pose 1 and pose 8 should be near the same resting endpoint for loops unless the specified action is a one-way transition. Do not merely rotate or translate an unchanged cutout: draw the actual body and hands in each action stage.

actions.name: 托腮·轻摇鲸尾
actions.actionPrompt: Both elbows stay planted. Viewer-left hand supports cheek, viewer-right forearm relaxed on desk; look warmly at user. Only the blue whale tail makes a lazy gentle wag behind viewer-right shoulder: 1 centered neutral, 2 curling slightly outward, 3 fin fully outward, 4 halfway back, 5 neutral with one brief blink, 6 fin tucks inward, 7 halfway return, 8 neutral eyes open. Keep tail visibly connected behind torso, hair silhouette coherent and face nearly still. Gentle comfortable company, no energetic dance.

actions.name: 托腮·指尖拨头发
actions.actionPrompt: Viewer-left hand continues supporting cheek for ALL eight poses. Viewer-right hand is the only hand that moves, from tabletop toward a cyan hair lock beside viewer-right cheek: 1 relaxed hand on desk, 2 elbow remains planted while hand rises halfway, 3 fingertips reach the curl, 4 index finger loosely hooks the hair tip, 5 idly twirls the curl once around finger, 6 releases the lock, 7 hand descends, 8 relaxed hand back on desk. Keep two arms and two hands only. Small shy smile; no grabbing ears, no changing hair length, no swapping supporting hand.

actions.name: 托腮·摇头哼歌
actions.actionPrompt: Both forearms stay resting, viewer-left hand loosely props cheek. Quietly humming to herself while looking at user: 1 neutral smile/head upright, 2 head leans 5 degrees left, 3 slight open humming mouth, 4 head returns through center with eyes closed happily, 5 head leans 5 degrees right with small rounded humming mouth, 6 returns halfway, 7 eyes open/head centered, 8 neutral smile. Small natural neck/shoulder sway and tail follows subtly; not whole-image tilting. No musical note symbols, no text, no microphone. This is a silent visual animation.

actions.name: 托腮办公·拿出并打开电脑
actions.actionPrompt: ONE-WAY transition from cheek-rest to computer work, no reset in final pose. Exactly one small plain slate-blue laptop, no logo or text. Poses: 1 no laptop, viewer-left palm supports cheek, other forearm on desk; 2 release cheek and BOTH hands reach just below screen-edge/table baseline; 3 both hands lift a CLOSED laptop from below until its top edge appears; 4 closed laptop rests on invisible table centered in front of torso, fingers on lid; 5 one hand stabilizes base while other lifts lid to 35 degrees; 6 lid opens to 75 degrees; 7 laptop stays open at 100 degrees, two hands approach keyboard; 8 comfortably leaning forward, both hands on keyboard, looking downward at screen. Laptop back faces viewer, keyboard toward character, visible small side view, never disconnected from hands. Same elbow baseline in all poses, top of head stays same height. Laptop never covers eyes.

actions.name: 托腮办公·轻敲键盘
actions.actionPrompt: LOOP of quiet work with exactly ONE small plain slate-blue laptop already OPEN at 100 degrees centered in front of torso in every pose. Laptop back faces viewer, keyboard toward character. Maintain identical laptop size and angle throughout; no text/logo. Both elbows on invisible desk, hands reach naturally behind lid to keyboard. 1 calm eyes on screen/hands poised, 2 left fingers press keys, 3 right fingers press keys, 4 both fingertips raised slightly, 5 eyes glance down and blink, 6 left fingers press, 7 right fingers press, 8 calm poised neutral. Subtle breathing, keep head level, tail small wag. Hands may be partly occluded by laptop, never floating over lid or three hands.

actions.name: 托腮办公·停笔想一想
actions.actionPrompt: LOOP with exactly ONE small plain slate-blue laptop OPEN at 100 degrees in front of torso for all poses, same screen position/size as quiet typing. Viewer-right hand remains at keyboard; viewer-left elbow remains planted. 1 both hands on keyboard looking at screen, 2 left hand lifts from keyboard, 3 left hand reaches cheek, 4 rests cheek on left palm looking thoughtfully at screen, 5 briefly glances up toward user with thoughtful smile, 6 looks back to screen, 7 left hand lowers, 8 both hands return to keyboard neutral. Two hands only. No floating question marks, no speech bubbles, no writing props.

actions.name: 托腮办公·揉眼伸肩
actions.actionPrompt: LOOP with exactly ONE small plain slate-blue laptop OPEN at 100 degrees centered in front of torso in every pose. Stay seated leaning at invisible desk. 1 both hands typing neutral, 2 viewer-right hand leaves keyboard while left stays, 3 right fingertips gently rub near right eye (not poke eyeball), 4 hand lowers, 5 both hands return to keyboard and shoulders gently lift in small stretch, 6 shoulders relax and head inclines slightly, 7 eyes reopen with refreshed smile, 8 neutral typing-ready. No standing, no full-body jump, no moving laptop, no extra hands.

actions.name: 托腮办公·收起电脑
actions.actionPrompt: ONE-WAY transition from computer work back to cheek-rest, no looping reset. Exactly ONE plain slate-blue laptop. 1 laptop open at 100 degrees in front of torso, both hands at keyboard looking at screen; 2 stop typing and hand reaches upper lid; 3 lower lid to 50 degrees with other hand stabilizing base; 4 fully closed laptop on invisible desktop; 5 both hands lift closed laptop slightly; 6 both hands lower it beneath invisible desk/screen bottom until out of sight; 7 no laptop, left elbow plants and hand rises toward cheek; 8 no laptop, viewer-left palm supports cheek and viewer-right forearm rests on desk, smiling at user like reference. Keep head scale and table baseline fixed. Do not make laptop vanish while open.
